claims: In the United States, the 2026 World Baseball Classic (WBC) is broadcast across the FOX Sports family of networks, including FOX, FS1, FS2, and FOX Deportes.
2026 World Baseball Classic (WBC) games can be streamed live on FOX One, Fubo, Hulu + Live TV, and YouTube TV.
All 47 games of the 2026 World Baseball Classic (WBC) are available on FOX One.
41 games of the 2026 World Baseball Classic (WBC) are broadcast on FOX Deportes, FOX One, and Tubi.
Audio coverage of the 2026 World Baseball Classic (WBC) is available on SiriusXM.
Audio coverage of the 2026 World Baseball Classic (WBC) is free on MLB.com.
The 2026 World Baseball Classic (WBC) tournament runs from March 4–17, 2026.
The Championship game of the 2026 World Baseball Classic (WBC) is on March 17, 2026.
The Championship game of the 2026 World Baseball Classic (WBC) features the United States and Venezuela.
In Canada, 2026 World Baseball Classic (WBC) games can be viewed on Sportsnet (English).
In Canada, 2026 World Baseball Classic (WBC) games can be viewed on TVA Sports (French).
In Japan, all games of the 2026 World Baseball Classic (WBC) are available on Netflix Japan.
